question: Can one current performed moment remain dominant while a small amount of immediately relevant causal context supports comprehension without turning historical material into another current Stage, transcript authority or a permanent Archive mode?
accepted_grammar: One current performed moment remains the dominant live Stage meaning.
Immediately relevant prior material may sit adjacent only when it explains why the present moment matters.
Historical material remains explicitly historical at every disclosure depth and does not become current-state material by opening or selection.
Current performance -> adjacent cause -> deeper causal history -> exact return is navigation/disclosure, not replay, rollback or Undo.
Current unresolved questions may remain current while pointing toward historical causal material.
Narrow layouts sequence current performance, causal context and deeper history without requiring simultaneous columns.
cross_lane_boundaries: No transcript ontology or density law is frozen.
No transcript-dependent animation, cadence or succession claim is made; Q-DESIGN-02 remains blocked.
No timer/Pause semantics, Take/consequence acceptance, Observed Cues authority or provider/Performer mechanics are created.

defects_repaired: Initial illustrative Scene-12 Stage witness incorrectly placed Mira in the current Scene, conflicting with the frozen whole-Production Character-management study where Mira is explicitly off-Scene relative to Scene 12.
Mira was replaced with Keir in the Stage witness; no Character-management authority or Scene membership was changed.

explicit_non_authority: No replacement or redesign of PKT-STAGE-CORE-02.
No final transcript, performance-history, timing, motion, acceptance or consequence architecture.
No final palette, typeface, material, iconography, native control or WinUI implementation claim.
No Phase-D, provider, runtime, validation or shipping authority.
next_boundary: Detail selected Character + Stage state inspection as a static Stage-specific handoff: preserve speaking/listening/current-opportunity/creator-selection distinctions and contextual inspection without inventing new state semantics, redundant identity symbols, pips, motion or Product-gated controls.
